svg.text: One crimson lane in the gutter per route, outermost lane = longest
reach. Read a lane as: this failure sends the run back there, at most
this many times, then the terminal escape takes over.
the outline commits to a section or figure that the evidence ledger cannot
carry at the grade the section asserts
a figure promised by the accepted outline is absent from, or unreadable
the native artifact is malformed, references a figure path that does not
exist, or cites a ledger entry id that does not exist
a delivered claim is unsupported, over-graded, or rests alone on a tier
that spec 9.2 forbids to carry it
a named disclosure predicate fails against the delivered text
the delivered package does not match the package the contract promised
validate_run.py closure rejected the receipt, so the run state is not
artifacts evaluated when file is deliverable
Review Mechanical, Review Evidence, Review Disclosure
Each card carries its own ceiling: cost · latency · retries.
Every node also carries reads, writes, preconditions, postconditions,
an activation guard, permission requirements and an admission reason.
None of that fits on a card without making the card unreadable, and the
manifest already holds it in a form you can grep. Read the picture for
shape and recovery; read the manifest for contracts.
